author: Jeff Geerling

Wi-Fi still required phone lines for a time. A belated #MARCHintosh video.

  - Raspberry Pi 3, 4, or 5 (or equivalent) ($35)
  - StarTech.com 56K USB Dial-up Modem ($45): https://amzn.to/3NJMeTZ
  - Viking DLE-200B Two-Way Line Simulator ($120): https://amzn.to/3NnJETN
  - (Optional, but retro-cool) Traditional Bell-style telephone ($36): https://amzn.to/3PPmpme
